title: Booking a doctor's appointment
instructions: Bir adam doktor randevusu almaya çalışıyor. Önerilen ve kabul edilen günleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Hello. I'd like an appointment with Dr Lee, please. I have a bad headache every day.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Dr Lee is on holiday this week. Dr Patel is free on Wednesday at ten.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Sorry, I work on Wednesday mornings. What about Thursday?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Dr Patel is free on Thursday at four thirty.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Yes, that's good. Thursday at four thirty.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Can I have your name and phone number?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Thank you, Mr Yilmaz. Please come ten minutes early.

questions.feedback: Her gün kötü baş ağrısı oluyor.
questions.evidence: I have a bad headache every day.

questions.prompt: Why can't he see Dr Lee?
questions.evidence: Dr Lee is on holiday this week.

questions.prompt: Why can't he go on Wednesday?

questions.feedback: Randevu perşembe dört buçukta, Dr Patel ile.
